description: Crofton thread density vs SIM-2026-016 sigma_by_dr: re-analysis of existing CMI data against sin(pi*dr/N) prediction
crofton_formula: sigma_Crofton(dr) = C * sin(pi*dr/N), normalized at dr=1
actual_sigma_profile: power_law: sigma ~ dr^(-0.99) on log-log (dr=2..12), NOT sinusoidal
key_finding: Amplitude ratio (7.78 vs 7.66, 1.6% agreement) is a coincidence. The Crofton sin(pi*dr/N) profile shape fails catastrophically (max residual 5863% at dr=12). sigma(dr) is a power law ~ dr^(-0.87), inconsistent with any sinusoidal Crofton form.
interpretation: The SIM-2026-016 sigma data does NOT match the chi=3 Crofton tessellation prediction. The amplitude ratio agreement noted in HYP-2026-014 is numerical coincidence: sin(pi*12/24)/sin(pi*1/24) = 7.66 happens to match sigma(1)/sigma(12) = 7.78, but the intermediate points are wildly wrong. The data is better described as a power law (sigma ~ dr^(-0.87)) reflecting the CMI decay structure of the critical TFIM, not a Crofton sinusoidal density.
notes: SIM-2026-016 used chi=2 MERA; a chi=3 re-test could give different sigma values. But the power-law form is robust and inconsistent with Crofton prediction regardless.
